connector.name: RFP.ai
connector.registryDescription: Draft cited RFP and security questionnaire answers from your knowledge base, with human review
connector.summary: Hosted at rfp.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.rfp, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> — create a scoped API token in rfp.ai Settings (read-only by default; write scopes granted per token)
